scenes.name: beat1_hook
scenes.text: Stop spending three days configuring Docker, Webpack, and database migrations. Watch this: I just built a production full-stack web app in under twelve minutes using Bolt dot new.

scenes.name: beat2_webcontainer
scenes.card_sub: No Node.js or Local Tools Required
scenes.text: You do not even need Node dot js installed. Inside a single browser tab, Bolt spins up a full WebContainer runtime with Vite, React, and Tailwind directly in memory.

scenes.name: beat3_codegen
scenes.text: Type what you want in plain English. It creates the database schemas, writes the authentication hooks, and live previews your application in real-time.

scenes.name: beat4_deploy
scenes.text: One click, and your entire application is deployed live to Netlify or Cloudflare Pages with SSL certificates, ready for real users.
